lastCompletedStory.title: Implement the BLOCK->re-plan loop with capped rounds and teardown seam

openQuestions: runPostAuditAction (plan-runner.ts) was NOT modified by this story: it still has no explicit case for the new 'plan-escalated' PlanPhaseResult kind (it would currently fall into the `planResult.kind !== 'audit-approved'` -> `{ kind: 'no-action' }` branch, silently skipping notifyFn/escalateFn). Per this story's notes AND US-004's notes ('runPostAuditAction may need a case for the new terminal kind'), wiring runPostAuditAction (or its caller, runPostPlanActions in sidecar.ts) to branch on 'plan-escalated' is explicitly assigned to US-004, which also owns constructing the real writeEscalationMarkerFn (adding writtenAt via a clock) and the real teardownPlanPanesFn (kill-pane, not respawn-pane -k, mirroring host.ts teardownWorkerPaneFn). Confirm in US-004 that the marker-writer seam introduced here (PlanEscalationWriterParams: issueId/summary/findings/roundsCompleted) is reused as-is rather than re-derived.

The ship-stalled marker precedent gitignore gap noted in US-002's handoff (.cam-ship-stalled.json missing from both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore) remains unaddressed; still out of scope for this story's diff.
nextStoryContext: US-003 added `runPlanPhaseWithReplan` (exported from src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) plus its options type `RunPlanPhaseWithReplanOptions` (extends RunPlanPhaseOptions with two OPTIONAL seams, both defaulting to a no-op closure: `teardownPlanPanesFn?: () => void` and `writeEscalationMarkerFn?: (params: PlanEscalationWriterParams) => void`) and a new exported type `PlanEscalationWriterParams = Omit<PlanEscalatedMarker, 'writtenAt'>` (issueId, summary, findings, roundsCompleted -- imports the PlanEscalatedMarker TYPE ONLY from plan-escalation.ts, no runtime dependency). PlanPhaseResult (the discriminated union returned by BOTH runPlanPhase and runPlanPhaseWithReplan) gained a new terminal member: `{ kind: 'plan-escalated'; issue: IssueEntry; report: PlanVerdictReport; roundsCompleted: number }`. IMPORTANT: runPlanPhase itself is UNCHANGED and NEVER returns 'plan-escalated' -- only runPlanPhaseWithReplan produces it, on exhausting MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS (2) consecutive audit-blocked rounds. The loop: round 1 = bare runPlanPhase(opts); while audit-blocked and rounds remain, call teardown() then re-run runPlanPhase with selectIssueFn pinned to the blocked round's issue and plannerTaskPrompt built via buildReplanPlannerTaskPrompt(issueId, priorFindings) (from US-001); on final audit-approved, teardown() then return as-is; on final still-audit-blocked (round cap exhausted), call writeEscalationMarkerFn({issueId, summary, findings, roundsCompleted}) THEN teardown() THEN return the new 'plan-escalated' kind; any non-audit kind from round 1 (preflight-failed, no-plannable-issue, mutex-busy, planner-timeout, auditor-timeout, planner-failed, container-preflight-failed) is returned as-is with ZERO teardown calls and ZERO re-plan rounds. US-004 (wire the re-plan loop + pane teardown + durable escalation into the sidecar) must: (a) in src/commands/sidecar.ts makeProductionPlanPhaseFn, call runPlanPhaseWithReplan instead of bare runPlanPhase, supplying a REAL teardownPlanPanesFn (kill-pane via a fresh readWorkerPaneMarker read, mirroring host.ts:398 teardownWorkerPaneFn -- NOT respawn-pane -k) and a REAL writeEscalationMarkerFn that constructs the full PlanEscalatedMarker (adds `writtenAt: new Date().toISOString()`) and calls writePlanEscalatedMarker(join(claudeDir, PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME), marker) from plan-escalation.ts (US-002); (b) add a branch in runPostAuditAction (or in runPostPlanActions, the sidecar.ts wrapper) for the 'plan-escalated' kind so notifyFn/escalateFn still fire and the phase exits to idle -- today it would silently fall into the `!== 'audit-approved'` -> no-action branch since runPostAuditAction was NOT touched by US-003; (c) on a converging plan run (audit-approved -> branch-created), call removePlanEscalatedMarker so a stale BLOCK escalation never outlives convergence (US-004 AC4). Test file test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-replan.test.ts (20 tests) is the precedent for asserting exact teardown-call counts and marker-writer-call-shape; mirror its makeReplanOpts fixture pattern (advance a shared roundIndex via the injected teardown closure) for any US-004 integration test that needs multi-round sidecar-level fixtures.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-003 only adds control-flow logic over existing intra-repo modules (plan-runner.ts, plan-escalation.ts types, events.ts); no new external npm library surface was exercised.
